topic: Reducing precision for visits frequency data
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on reducing the decimal precision of the `visits_frequency` metric, which currently returns a high number of decimal places and is stored in the database. It was agreed that the precision should be reduced to two decimal places across all relevant SQL queries (specifically mentioning `trafficScreenSql` and potentially `totalSql`). The participants concluded that this level of precision is sufficient for current needs.

Separately, there was a brief mention of setting up reporting formulas for a new location (Campinas), which will require similar formula development work.
decisions: Reduce the decimal precision of `visits_frequency` to two places.
